intro: The Ratchathewi–Pratunam area around Phyathai 1 is easy to get around if the hospital is your reason for the trip. The hospital is on Si Ayutthaya Road, about 500 metres from Phaya Thai BTS (exit 4) or 400 metres from the Ratchaprarop Airport Rail Link (exit 1). Most hotels cluster on the Pratunam side and along Phetchaburi Road, reaching the hospital gate in a few minutes on foot. Nearby you'll find convenience stores, Pratunam Market, Platinum Mall, and lots of places to eat. It suits patient families, people in for a check-up, and anyone making frequent trips to and from the hospital. If you want it quieter, avoid the busy Pratunam market side and pick a hotel on Si Ayutthaya Road or deeper into a soi.

blocks.html: Short answer: Phyathai 1 sits on Si Ayutthaya Road in Ratchathewi, close to Phaya Thai BTS and the Ratchaprarop Airport Rail Link, with plenty of hotels you can walk from on the Pratunam side. For a budget room within walking distance, look at My Hotel Pratunam or Baiyoke Boutique (from about ฿1,000). For a multi-day or recovery stay with a kitchen, Centre Point Pratunam has serviced apartments. For 4–5 star within walking distance there's The Sukosol and Pullman Bangkok King Power, from roughly ฿2,700 a night.

faq.q: Are there hotels within walking distance of Phyathai 1?
faq.a: Yes, several. Most hotels around the hospital are on the Pratunam side and along Phetchaburi Road and reach the Phyathai 1 gate in a few minutes. My Hotel Pratunam, Baiyoke Boutique, and Grand Alpine are about 200 metres away, while The Sukosol and Pullman Bangkok King Power are a walk of around 320–350 metres.

faq.q: How do I get to Phyathai 1 from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: The easiest way is the Airport Rail Link from Suvarnabhumi to Ratchaprarop station, then about a 400-metre walk to Phyathai 1. You can also stay on to Phaya Thai and walk roughly 500 metres. If you'd rather not walk, a taxi straight from the airport takes about 40–60 minutes depending on traffic.

faq.q: What kind of stay is best for a multi-day recovery?
faq.a: If you'll be there several days or recovering after treatment, look at a serviced apartment like Centre Point Pratunam, with spacious rooms, a fridge and microwave, and a small kitchen in some types so you can heat up or cook light meals, plus housekeeping. It's more comfortable than a single hotel room for longer stays with family helping out.
